headline: Cubbo Best Build
title: Cubbo Build | Claw Mark and Earthquake | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Cubbo is a sleepy Earth fighter in Aniimo with a simple combo. Use Fanatic Clawing, and the third hit doubles the Rage your next skill gains. Once Cubbo is Enraged, every hit adds Claw Marks, up to six. Then cast Earthquake. It clears every mark and deals extra damage for each one. So stack marks first, then stomp. Is Cubbo on your team? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Cubbo build: Fanatic Clawing builds Rage and Claw Marks, then Earthquake cashes them in for extra damage.
